slides.title: Learning and Progress
slides.text: Both nations have long traditions of learning and reform. Tunis is home to the Zitouna Mosque, one of the oldest centres of Islamic learning, and the 14th-century thinker Ibn Khaldun. Bahrain opened its first regular school in 1919 and the first girls' school in the Gulf in 1928. Tunisia became known as a pioneer in women's rights in the Arab world with its 1956 Code of Personal Status.
